qa_pair.question: A governed record carries both a label saying what kind of support stands behind its ruling and a stamp saying when it was last checked, and a routine re-check must never promote the label. Exactly two in-force records set out all three values that label may take; one only defines them, the other carries the argument for keeping the two fields apart. Give the repository-relative path of the record that carries the argument, exactly as the retrieval surface reports it.

The retrieval contract withholds the body of an over-long agent-facing rule file and serves a refusal instead. It says the line limit it applies is borrowed from one of the corpus's own research topics. Name that topic exactly as the guidance catalog spells it.

An adopter is configuring a search tool so that past positions stay out of default results. The corpus records one glob form as the one the route map states. Reply with that form only: the glob itself, without the surrounding backticks the records set it in.

A decision record is amended: the new text takes over the live file, and the text it displaced is preserved as its own archive entry. That entry's filename is built from the record's key plus a month stamp. Which numbered subsection of the change procedure prescribes that filename? Answer as a section number, for example 8.4.

A governed record settles which reviewer signs off on database schema changes. The team replaces that lone reviewer with a rotating pair who must both agree before anything ships. Under this corpus's change procedure, the rewritten record keeps its identifier. Answer True or False.

When a query matches no key and no title, the retrieval surface returns candidate keys instead of the best-scoring record body. The retrieval contract cites one decision record as the reason for that behaviour. Give that record's title exactly as the catalog spells it.
qa_pair.answer: Concept queries resolve through typed candidates
